property_summary: For any caller and any uint value v, calling SetMinSum(v) before Initialized() always sets MinSum == v in the reference; the mutant fails to update MinSum when intitalized is true and thus there exist sequences (call SetMinSum(v) after Initialized()) where MinSum differs — we capture this by fuzzing a value v and a boolean decide whether to initialize first and asserting MinSum equals the last SetMinSum call when allowed by spec (i.e., reference always sets MinSum to the provided v regardless of prior calls when intitalized is false), which the mutant violates for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Assign MinSum only when intitalized is false (explicit conditional assignment), otherwise leave unchanged; this makes the effect conditional but maintains no revert.
